decision_basis: Protocol frozen before any model fitting or performance inspection. Only target counts were inspected for descriptive reporting and the pre-specified fatal-class feasibility check.

frozen_population.prediction_scope: collision table only; conditional severity prediction

frozen_schema.feature_selection_rule: Model code must select exactly feature_columns from this schema; metadata and target columns are never selected by exclusion logic.

frozen_cleaning.unseen_categories: map to __UNSEEN__ using training vocabulary only
frozen_cleaning.rare_category_pooling: off by default; if used, thresholds are learned on training data only

temporal_protocol.final_test_rule: 2024 remains untouched by preprocessing fit, hyperparameter tuning, threshold choice and model selection; evaluate once after freezing.

random_reference_protocol.purpose: optimistic same-distribution reference, not a deployment estimate
random_reference_protocol.random_test_rule: Random test partitions are not used for preprocessing, tuning or model selection. Report mean and standard deviation across five seeds.
random_reference_protocol.secondary_2024_diagnostic: Pre-registered optional diagnostic: apply each already-fitted random split model to 2024 without retuning; report separately from the strict temporal protocol.

class_feasibility_preflight.interpretation: The threshold checks only that the class is not extremely sparse; it does not guarantee narrow confidence intervals. Fatal recall and all primary test metrics still require bootstrap confidence intervals.

frozen_metrics.uncertainty: paired, class-stratified nonparametric bootstrap over collision records within each test set; 2,000 iterations with random seed 20260828
